build_fbnet_model: build an FBNet model by creating an FBNetBuilder and calling build_blocks with a unified architecture definition
unify_arch_def: unify an architecture definition dict into a flat list of block dicts with stage and block indices
parse_block_cfgs: parse block configuration tuples into structured dicts with block_op, block_cfg, and repeat fields
count_strides: compute the cumulative stride across all blocks in a unified architecture definition
expand_repeats: expand repeated blocks in an architecture definition so each block has repeat equal to 1
